objective: Starting from stock llama.cpp and the official Muse Spark Open NVFP4 checkpoint, build an engine image that runs a mixed 2-bit requantization of the model (IQ2_XXS for the routed gate and up projections, Q2_K for down) with a prefill batch sized so a 2048-token prompt streams the experts once. The factory graph does the implementation: the converter and expert scale wiring the checkpoint needs, the base engine, the 2-bit pack, the batch plan, the image. The lab then measures once how much time to first token, decode rate and total request time change against the NVFP4 baseline. The two full weight production steps already ran twice. Verify their recorded outputs with read-only manifest, shard size and header census checks. Record the original job and duration separately from the verification time. All other work runs in this demo.

constraints.model_execution: Use capped_runner for production replays, builds and every model load. Every load requires the machine gate, 96 GiB cap and operator approval.
constraints.build_jobs: Builds use at most resources.build_jobs parallel jobs (the box is shared). Verifiers that compile take jobs of at most 4.
constraints.no_full_rehash: Do not ask a verifier to hash a whole pack (pass hash: false): reading 500 GB takes the disk for an hour. The checkpoint shard digests come from the hub's download metadata (operator input checkpoint_digests); pack headers are checked live.
constraints.agent_tools: Codex's own shell cannot start on this machine (its sandbox needs user namespaces the box does not allow). Read, edit and commit the owned checkout with factory.source_workbench (read, edit, write, localcommit); run everything else with capsule capabilities and factory.capped_runner. Do not retry the shell.
constraints.operator_records: The operator imports a few inputs as records of kind operator_input (the checkpoint digests from the hub download metadata, the earlier lab measurements) and records a host_reading at each run start (free disk, available memory, the cgroup now and the memory cap policy). Capped runs end with host records of kind capped_run. Find them with factory.evidence.query kinds ["operator_input", "host_reading", "capped_run"] and cite their ids.
constraints.workspace_files: Write working files under resources.verifier_inputs.work_dir. Linked production packs and manifests are read-only.

operator_labels.run: The two full weight production steps already ran twice. Verify their recorded outputs with read-only manifest, shard size and header census checks. Record the original job and duration separately from the verification time. All other work runs in this demo.

verifier_inputs.note: Inputs of the capsule verifiers; tiny packs and checkpoints are small test fixtures, not the model.

checkpoint_digests.how: operator: sha256 of every checkpoint shard from the Hugging Face download metadata (LFS etag, checked by the hub client at download, 2026-11-24), direct sha256 of the index, config, tokenizer and imatrix; no shard re-read. An input, not a product of this run.

earlier_lab_report.how: measurements of the Nov 25 overnight lab (hand-built engines, Q2_K pack), arms A to E, warm medians: context for planning, not evidence for this run's outputs.
earlier_lab_report.results: vs A (NVFP4 on E0): Q2_K (B) halves time to first token and lifts decode from 0.33 to 0.86 tok/s; the seeded cache (C) adds only on cold p512; the prefill batch (D) cuts p2048 TTFT from 607 s to 114 s. Arm E (D plus the decode expert fill, engine.build_expert_fill) is NEGATIVE: decode 0.25 tok/s against about 0.80 on B, C and D, because the fill re-reads experts the GPU cache already serves (5.55 TB read).

earlier_accuracy_timing.how: progress log of the Nov 25 paired MMLU run (hand-built E0, Q2_K pack against NVFP4, -np 32 -kvu -b 4096 -ub 4096, 32 questions per request): per-arm load and scoring seconds. Planning context for checkpoint timing, not evidence for this run.
earlier_accuracy_timing.results: 2-bit-class arm (Q2_K): load about 185 s, about 6.3 s per question (147 to 282 s per 32); NVFP4 arm: load 312 to 357 s, about 10.8 s per question (321 to 485 s per 32). Reaching the 250 checkpoint on both arms took about 80 min of scoring plus loads; 430 about 2.3 h.
